topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I stumbled across the truth by accident, a revelation that shouldn’t have been. My friend, someone I trusted, has been spinning a web of deceit about their job. Every word they've said, every story they've woven, now casts a shadow of uncertainty. I feel the ground beneath me shift, unsure of what to believe or who to trust. How do I confront them? What do I say when the very foundation of our friendship feels like it’s crumbling? I wish I could turn back time, to before I knew, when everything was simpler, when I didn’t see the cracks.
